title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Crocoblock…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Crocoblock JetElements For Elementor up to version 2.9.2.6. This flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers with limited privileges to inject malicious scripts that can impact confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 score of 6.5, indicating medium severity.
